entities.name: PMID:27505114
observations: Stokes et al. retrospective single-center cohort of 1,175 inpatients with positive C. difficile testing within 24 hours of admission (2005–2015), comparing medical with general/colorectal surgery services.
In-hospital mortality was 2.6% on surgery services versus 6.8% on medical services (p=0.028); adjusted OR 0.18 (95% CI 0.05–0.58). Propensity-matched rates were 2.6% versus 9.5%.
Authors note retrospective single-center limitations and possible contribution of higher colectomy rates; association does not establish causation. DOI: 10.1097/dcr.0000000000000643.

entities.name: Lower CDI mortality on surgery service
observations: In a 1,175-patient single-center retrospective cohort, surgery-service admission was associated with lower inpatient mortality than medical-service admission: 2.6% versus 6.8%; adjusted OR 0.18 (95% CI 0.05–0.58). Propensity-matched mortality was 2.6% versus 9.5%.
